details:
**Project Chronos: Odyssey of the Silent Fleet** is a free, browser-based interactive story game created by Team AI Crakers for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

### What it is

You play as a Cadet in the fictional Orbital Preservation Corps. A “Temporal Decay Wave” is erasing the records of real NASA spacecraft that finished their missions (or are still drifting silently). With the help of TOCK, a friendly archive-bot, you restore those records one mission at a time.

Everything is labeled clearly:

- **Real** — actual NASA history and science

- **Story** — the fictional frame

- **Simplified Model** — educational simplifications

### How it works (same loop for every mission)

1. **Explore** — Tap glowing hotspots in the spacecraft’s scene

2. **Build** — Drag-and-drop the main parts onto an assembly sheet and learn what each one does

3. **Challenge** — Play a short mini-game unique to that mission

4. **Evidence Vault** — Unlock sealed files that cite real NASA sources and link to images

5. **Final Signal** — See the different ways a mission can “end” (power loss, last signal, official closeout) and earn badges

Progress saves automatically in the browser. It works on phones and desktops, and includes accessibility options (sound off, motion off, color tint, keyboard support).

### Missions

The live version covers multiple eras:

- Earth orbit

- Moon (Surveyor 3, Apollo 11 Eagle, Lunar Roving Vehicle, and others)

- Mars

- Asteroids

- Deep space

Each has its own animated sky and color theme. The original presentation highlighted five core missions (Explorer 1, Surveyor 3, Opportunity, NEAR Shoemaker, and Pioneer 10), and the site expands on that foundation.

### Why it matters

Textbooks list dates and specs. Chronos lets kids *do* the history — explore, assemble, and play — while keeping fiction and fact carefully separated. The tagline sums it up: *“Machines may fall silent. Their discoveries never do.”*

**Live project:** [https://cronos-7pvq.vercel.app/](https://cronos-7pvq.vercel.app/)
